answer: The admission bond is time locked for 12 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in river, expire in quartz, and haven lists each expiry. An farming party running 158 aliases as a result needs 200 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 45 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
